# Contributing Guidelines
### Content

- [Opening an Issue](#opening-an-issue)
- [Submitting pull requests](#submitting-pull-requests)

> **These guidelines should be followed by the users wanted to contribute to the planning service.**

## Opening an Issue
Open issues to request feature or signal bugs. Make sure that you are using the latest version of the project before opening an issue. Do no open a duplicate issue, check that no issues describing your problem already exist.

## Submitting Pull Requests
You can propose new features or fix bugs through pull request.

- **Follow the existing coding style:** Keep your code consistent with the style and formatting of the repo.
- **Document your code:** Make sure that your code is well documented
- **Add unit tests:** If relevant, add unit tests for your code
